goal.decided: The user has each deliverable they mean made by rn, every deliverable meeting each intent of its best practice, and is asked only what is theirs.

deliverables.name: Every prose ccpm keeps is checked by lovaizu/checks
Each best practice holds the field's established way, named so its maker grasps the intent

decisions.decided: the questions ask where makers of the kind fail the role, as a run made without the best practice shows and the field's sources name, not one for each section, as a list of the failures that matter works where a list for completeness doesn't

decisions.about: A question an evaluator can be trusted on
decisions.decided: a question is used once an evaluator judges it right on several kept deliverables whose answer is known, passes and fails among them, as two verdicts on one deliverable show no reliability
a kind whose deliverable is one document gives a template, and a kind whose deliverable is a set of files of a known form, such as code or a prompt, names its parts instead
each practice is the way the field has established for its case, found by research and named with its source, not reasoned out alone

decisions.about: How a practice names an idea
decisions.decided: a practice calls an established idea by its established name, such as single responsibility or Given-When-Then, with why it serves the role, as the name carries the field's whole knowledge to a maker who knows it

the maker searches the field's primary sources and its established guides, weighs each by its authority, writes where sources disagree which way it takes and why, and stops once new sources add nothing
a practice holds for any language and tool the kind is made with, and names one only as an example, as a practice tied to one language fails a deliverable made in another
a practice gives the intent, its established ways, and when each fits, and the design tree picks the way and the tool for each deliverable's case, settled with the user where it's theirs

each practice holds its established name and other names it goes by, what the deliverable must be and why, where it applies and where it doesn't, what it costs, and its sources, as the pattern form and Google's rules with pros and cons give
a step is given only where skipping it or doing it out of order breaks the deliverable, and each such step gets its trace; the rest is left to the maker who holds the intent
the best practice gives examples that differ from one another where the kind allows, so the maker takes the intent and not one product's particulars
the evaluation comes first: real cases of the kind are made without the best practice, the shortfalls are kept, and the best practice holds what closes them, then is tried on cases held back

deliverables.name: A maker of code designs it, tests it first, and writes it as the field's established practice says

decisions.decided: the code's design, design patterns, test design, test-driven development, and the test code, each held to the same design principles as the code it tests; made anew from the goal, not by adding to what stands

each function stays simple enough to grasp and to test, its cyclomatic complexity measured by a machine against McCabe's established limit of 10, with its size and copied code, on the code and its tests alike, so the evaluator reads only what no machine measures, such as cohesion and coupling, which have no established limit; the plan picks the tool and any other limit for its case
which module may depend on which is a rule the design states, checked by a machine where the language has a tool for it and read by the evaluator where it has none; the plan picks the tool

decisions.about: How the best practice shows it works
decisions.decided: code made by it leaves few findings to mutation testing, property-based testing, and CI: surviving mutants, with those marked as not to be mutated counted beside them, counterexamples a property finds, and CI failures after the local checks pass, each lower than the last; the evaluator's questions judge the design these tools can't see

deliverables.name: A maker changes the structure of existing code without changing what it does
A maker of a Claude Code plugin finds the field's established way for each of its parts

decisions.about: What is the field's and what is this repository's
decisions.decided: Claude Code's documented behavior stays as the field's facts, and this repository's own choices, such as Lane as the guard, lay.py, tree.py, Python 3.9 with its standard library, and the folders rn writes, go to the plugin deliverables of the design tree

roles that run at the same time each work in a workspace of their own, such as a git worktree and a temporary folder no other role writes, and their results join only through the one who started them, as two makers in one workspace overwrite each other's files unseen

deliverables.name: A maker of a design finds the field's established way to lay out a product's parts and its test levels
A writer of a prompt finds the field's established way to have an AI do the task as meant
A planner finds the field's established way to plan work back from its goal
This plan holds every deliverable the goal needs, each after what it stands on
A writer of a README finds the field's established way to have a newcomer choose and start
A writer of a product vision finds the field's established way to say what a product is for
An editor of a document finds the field's established way to have it read as its writer meant

the tests a change reaches and coverage run before each push, and every test, Cosmic Ray's mutation testing, and Hypothesis's properties run in CI, as a full mutation run takes hours and fills the disk
